HPQ.thesis: Cheap cash-flow yield plus an AI-PC refresh kicker; Printing funds the bet. Fiscal Q3 is the next proof point.

CEG.thesis: Existing nuclear scarcity, Calpine diversification, and long-duration customer contracts. Q2 must prove integration and cash conversion.

HOOD.thesis: Financial-sector leadership plus Robinhood growth and a rising blockchain-fee thesis.

JBS.thesis: Global protein momentum position. August 10 earnings must validate margin resilience and cash conversion; until then the public operating thesis is provisional.

LTH.thesis: Life Time is turning the gym into a high-retention social club and wellness third place. Family-heavy memberships, recurring dues, and resort-like centers can deepen engagement; Q2 must prove that community value converts into durable center economics.

BYDDY.thesis: China EV recovery plus export growth and geopolitical-risk compression. Robotics is credible optionality but remains unproven; August deliveries must hold above 400K.

BRBR.thesis: Legacy Robinhood protein holding. The GLP-1 muscle-preservation theme does not currently provide a clean BRBR-specific public-equity expression; retain it transparently while brand-level volume, pricing, and margin evidence either creates a direct thesis or invalidates it.

MOS.thesis: Mosaic is a fertilizer-cycle recovery position, not a clean momentum trade. Q2 still showed a $273 million net loss and sulfur-cost pressure despite $407 million of adjusted EBITDA; reduced phosphate output, lower costs, and $1.2 billion capex guidance must translate into better cash generation before conviction rises.

AAON.thesis: AAON is a data-center cooling and custom HVAC capacity-ramp position. Record BASX demand and a $2.0 billion backlog must convert into revenue, improving gross margin, and cash generation faster than Memphis overhead, outsourcing, and working-capital needs consume the upside.

NKE.thesis: Nike is a brand-and-distribution turnaround position. Wholesale growth and performance-product traction must become durable revenue and margin recovery while NIKE Direct, Greater China, inventory units, and tariff exposure stop consuming the upside.

BOT.thesis: RoboStrategy is a closed-end private-robotics access position. Monthly NAV growth and portfolio-company financing or liquidity events must outrun the stock's premium to stale Level 3 marks, a 3.98% estimated expense load, dilution, and weak price discovery.

CYPH.thesis: Cypherpunk is primarily a leveraged Zcash-treasury position with a capital-hungry oncology option. ZEC per diluted share and liquidity must rise without destructive issuance while any sirexatamab Phase 3 path is funded outside the treasury thesis.

GRND.thesis: Grindr is a high-margin subscription-network position. Paying-user and ARPPU growth must sustain roughly 40% adjusted EBITDA margins while product expansion broadens monetization without weakening trust, safety, privacy, or the core community.

OSCR.thesis: Oscar Health is an ACA individual-market scale position. Membership growth and technology-led operating leverage must preserve medical-cost discipline as enhanced subsidies expire and 2027 integrity rules test enrollment quality, pricing, and retention.

CF.thesis: CF Industries is a nitrogen-cycle cash-flow position. Tight global supply and strong plant utilization support pricing, but the thesis requires Q3 volume recovery and durable free cash flow rather than conflict-driven price spikes.

WAY.thesis: Waystar is a healthcare-payment software compounder: subscription growth, 108% retention, and 43% adjusted EBITDA margin must keep converting provider complexity into recurring cash flow without acquisition or leverage drag.

WEAT.thesis: WEAT is a directional wheat-futures position, not an operating-company thesis. The trade needs tightening USDA supply estimates or weather/geopolitical disruption to outrun futures-curve roll drag, fees, and a reversal in wheat prices.

FIGR.thesis: Figure is a capital-light consumer-credit marketplace position. Loan volume, Figure Connect adoption, and partner growth must translate into durable adjusted revenue and earnings without credit deterioration, warehouse-funding stress, or mark-to-market noise masking economics.

FRMI.thesis: A development-stage bet on Project Matador becoming a scarce, gigawatt-scale powered AI campus. Commercial agreements and funded delivery—not headline capacity—must validate it.

MDB.thesis: Momentum position in database software: the recovery above the 50-day and 200-day averages must hold into tentative August 25 earnings and the August 28 $400 call expiry.

BMNR.thesis: Ethereum adoption thesis: Robinhood Chain is an Ethereum L2 aimed at tokenized real-world assets, while a crypto-friendly U.S. policy backdrop and depressed Web3 valuations create rerating optionality; BMNR must grow ETH per share faster than dilution and operating drag.

XYL.thesis: AI data-center buildouts require cooling, treatment, reuse, measurement, and discharge water systems that Xylem supplies; the position stays starter-sized while the quote sits near the top of the DCF range.

PL.thesis: Planet's daily Earth-imagery archive can compound into a recurring geospatial-data platform as defense, intelligence, and sovereign demand grows; Pelican execution and backlog conversion must outrun launch risk, capital intensity, and dilution.

JCI.thesis: AI data-center cooling demand is accelerating Johnson Controls' orders and backlog, but this is a momentum starter near all-time highs; service-backlog conversion, margins, and cash flow must prove the install wave becomes durable earnings.

HIMS.thesis: Hims & Hers is a subscription-health platform and international expansion position. Subscriber growth and personalized care must sustain domestic reacceleration and profitable scale while regulatory, pharmacy, acquisition-integration, and product-mix risks remain controlled.

NET.thesis: More software, security traffic, APIs, and AI agents should increase demand for Cloudflare's network and developer platform, but growth and margin expansion must outrun an unforgiving valuation.

RBLX.thesis: Roblox can become a durable cultural platform if its youth audience ages into higher-spending adults while creators, advertising, and AI-assisted discovery deepen the economy faster than safety, infrastructure, and dilution consume the upside.

RDDT.thesis: Authentic human conversation should become scarcer as the web fills with generated content, while ads, search, international monetization, and disciplined licensing convert that scarcity into cash flow.

TMO.thesis: Thermo Fisher is a durable life-science picks-and-shovels compounder, but end-market recovery and margin execution must justify a valuation that still leaves little room for disappointment.

ADBE.thesis: Adobe's installed base, subscription cash flow, and AI-first products can preserve the creative-workflow moat, but AI monetization and Semrush integration must outpace native-model substitution, leadership transition risk, and multiple compression.

MU.thesis: HBM scarcity and binding customer agreements must extend the memory cycle without triggering reckless supply growth.

ZS.thesis: Zero Trust platform consolidation and AI security demand must sustain core ARR growth while cash margins recover and dilution falls.

SIEGY.flair: Tracked thesis · industrial AI and electrification
SIEGY.why_owned: No live position; mirrored from the thesis watchlist for operating and valuation proof.
SIEGY.position_role: Industrial automation, electrification, and infrastructure compounder
SIEGY.thesis: Industrial AI, data-center electrification, software, and mobility backlogs can sustain profitable growth while the planned Healthineers spin sharpens the portfolio.
SIEGY.thesis_risk: A short-cycle automation rollover, weaker China demand, Healthineers execution, FX, or paying a premium multiple for peak backlog conversion.

CRM.flair: Tracked thesis · agentic CRM plus capital return
CRM.why_owned: No live position. Tracking whether Agentforce and Data 360 can reaccelerate organic growth while margins and cash compound.
CRM.position_role: Enterprise software and agentic-AI watchlist exposure.
CRM.thesis: Salesforce now trades at a legacy-software multiple while cRPO, Agentforce and Data 360 grow faster; the catch is acquisition-heavy growth and a debt-funded $25B buyback.
CRM.biggest_risk: Informatica masks weak organic growth while debt-funded buybacks, stock compensation, and an engineering-leadership transition muddy per-share execution.
CRM.kill_criteria: Close below the roughly $172 50-day average, Q2 cRPO under 12%, guidance cut, or the engineering-leadership transition disrupts Agentforce execution.
CRM.entry_trigger: Close above the roughly $204 200-day average on above-average volume, then follow through $209–$211; alternatively Q2 confirms cRPO near 14% with guidance intact.

CRWV.thesis: CoreWeave is a leveraged AI-infrastructure demand position. A $104 billion backlog and more than $25 billion of early-Q3 commitments must convert into delivered capacity, revenue, and operating leverage faster than debt, interest, capex, and customer concentration consume the upside.

CTVA.thesis: Corteva is a seed-pricing, crop-protection productivity, and separation position. Seed technology and cost discipline must preserve margin growth while the September investor days and October Vylor spin create two investable companies without operational disruption or stranded costs.

DASH.thesis: DoorDash is a local-commerce network position. Order and GOV growth, DashPass engagement, Deliveroo integration, and grocery/retail unit economics must compound faster than insurance, regulation, autonomy investment, and international complexity consume the margin upside.

LYV.thesis: Live Nation is a live-events demand and venue-capacity position. Record ticket sales and deferred revenue must convert into double-digit adjusted operating income and cash flow while legal remedies, capital intensity, weather, and artist or fan affordability do not impair the flywheel.

TOST.thesis: Toast is a restaurant operating-system and payments position. Location and GPV growth, enterprise adoption, AI products, and margin expansion must compound without weaker restaurant demand, payments compression, credit losses, or hardware and support costs eroding the economics.

DJT.thesis: Trump Media is an event-driven media, digital-asset, and pending TAE-merger position. Truth Social and Truth+ monetization, transaction execution, and disciplined capital allocation must create per-share value faster than operating losses, crypto volatility, convertible debt, dilution, and merger risk consume it.

XLE.thesis: XLE is a concentrated S&P 500 energy-sector allocation. Elevated oil cash flows, disciplined capital spending, and shareholder returns must outweigh commodity normalization, weak natural-gas prices, concentration in integrated majors, and the fund's 0.08% expense ratio.

PAYX.thesis: Paychex is a payroll and human-capital-management compounder with Paycor integration upside. Fiscal 2027 organic growth, cross-selling, and margin expansion must outrun acquisition amortization, debt costs, labor-market softness, and an expensive recurring-revenue multiple.

AVAV.thesis: AeroVironment is a defense-autonomy and unmanned-systems backlog-conversion position. BlueHalo integration, funded orders, and supply-chain execution must turn fiscal 2026's acquisition-led scale into durable organic growth, margins, and cash flow.

LULU.thesis: lululemon is a brand-and-margin recovery position. North American stabilization, international growth, and inventory discipline must restore gross margin and earnings without relying on buybacks or perpetual discounting.

SBUX.thesis: Starbucks is a turnaround-expectations short. Better transactions and margins are real, but the short requires Back to Starbucks labor and restructuring spend, China economics, and one-off benefits to keep durable earnings below what the near-high valuation implies.
